map.剩余天数 = floor((有效期 − 今天) ÷ 86400000)，两端均按: Remaining days = floor((expiry date − today) ÷ 86400000), with both ends normalised to midnight of the day before subtraction to avoid half-day errors. Grades: <0 days expired (red); ≤30 days urgent (orange); ≤90 days attention (yellow); ≤180 days watch (yellow); >180 days safe (green). The list is sorted by remaining days ascending with the nearest first, and can be filtered by status with counts per status.
map.以 2026-09-10 为基准：某药品有效期 2026-10-01，剩余 21: Using 2026-09-10 as the baseline: a medicine expiring on 2026-10-01 has 21 days remaining → judged "urgent" and should be used first or replaced as soon as possible; another batch expiring on 2026-12-31 has 112 days remaining → judged "attention", can circulate normally but should go into next quarter's first-expiry-first plan; anything expiring before 2026-09-10 always shows "expired", must be stopped immediately and recycled per regulations, and must not be taken further.
map.过了有效期一天的药还能吃吗？: Can a medicine one day past expiry still be taken?
map.不建议。有效期是生产企业在规定贮存条件下对含量与安全性负责的截止日，过期后有效成: No. The expiry date is the date up to which the manufacturer guarantees content and safety under stated storage conditions; after that the active ingredients may degrade and impurities may increase. This matters especially for potency-sensitive drugs such as insulin, nitroglycerin, adrenaline and antibiotics, where loss of potency can directly cause treatment failure. Unchanged appearance does not mean potency is still adequate, and expired medicines should be recycled per regulations rather than taken.
map.为什么按批号而不是按药名管理？: Why manage by batch number rather than by drug name?
map.同一药名的不同批次有效期不同，只记药名会把近效期与远期批次混在一起，失去预警意义: Different batches of the same drug name have different expiry dates, so recording only the name mixes near-expiry and far-expiry batches and destroys the point of the alert. Registering by batch number and applying first-expiry-first-out significantly reduces the expiry rate; issuing and taking should also follow first-in-first-out, and the batch number and expiry should be retained after splitting a pack.
map.记录药品名称、批号和有效期，自动计算剩余天数并按效期排序，通过颜色分级（绿/黄/: Record medicine names, batch numbers and expiry dates, automatically compute remaining days and sort by expiry, and use four-level colour grading (green/yellow/orange/red) for intuitive alerts to help you handle near-expiry and expired medicines promptly.
